data.name: Harshit Saran
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Harshit Saran has made a big mark in cricket. With 41 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 100*, with an average of 19.88 and a quick strike rate of 162.24. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 33 sixes and 60 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 67.5 overs, taking 30 wickets at an economy rate of 9.85. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
